text:
Harper Lin: hi team! Harper here — just started on Platform Eng today. i'm remote (portland) but coming to SF week of april 6. small thing: i'm borderline obsessive about folding (origami, perfectly folded napkins, burritos). also bringing a mug covered in tiny origami cranes. any chance there's a mug rack or community shelf on the 3rd floor where it can live? :crane:
WelcomeBot: welcome to Redwood, Harper! :wave: Check out the #new-hires welcome doc: <https://redwood.company/welcome>. You should get a calendar invite for the new-hire lunch.
Becca S: welcome Harper!! there is a little mug shelf by the kitchenette on 3rd floor, near the compost bin. it's first-come, first-serve tho. some folks label with tape. :)
Jamal: hey Harper, hi! :tada: i left a post-it label roll on the shelf yesterday — free for mug-stickers. if you want, i'll save you a spot and stick a crane sticker on it.
Harper Lin: omg amazing, Jamal — thank you! i'll bring a tiny paper crane to glue on. does labeling with name + team etiquette still hold? i've seen some mugs get reclaimed by interns before...
Noel: yes name + emoji is the unofficial law. also if you're in on tuesday there's a quick office tour at 11:30 — meets by lobby.
Mira Patel: welcome!! i'm in infra and i bring plants to any desk that looks lonely. if your mug needs a buddy plant to keep it company, ping me and i'll drop off a pothos.
Jamal: also FYI we do a casual "show-and-tell" at Friday coffee sometimes — would love a quick demo of origami folds if you're into it. 5 minute slot. :eyes:
Harper Lin: that sounds so fun — count me in for a 5-min demo on Friday! i'll practice a crane and a tiny fox. thanks for the warm welcome, everyone. super excited to be here. :heart:
Becca S: welcome aboard!! we'll save you a seat at lunch. PS — the kitchen has a tiny hot-water station for green tea if that's your thing.
Noel: adding you to the SF office Slack thread so you get meetup pings. see you soon!
Harper Lin: cheers all — i'll bring extra paper for people who want to try folding at lunch :paperclip:
